title: Adherence components
summary: Assign transparent components for class-level adherence. PDC is effective covered observed days divided by observed days. The supplied MPR numerator sums each fill's supplied days clipped to the calendar window, including carry-in and overlapping fills; it is not observation-intersected and can exceed the denominator. These are explicit study conventions, not a universal adherence definition. Zero or missing denominator yields NA.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
